newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Guangzhou completes subway foreign loans.
newsitem.headline: China's Guangzhou completes subway foreign loans.

text.p: China has finally obtained all the foreign loans it needs for construction of an underground rail system in the southern boomtown of Guangzhou, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.
The 540,000 sterling ($864,000) contract to import fans for Guangzhou subway had been signed recently with General Electric Co, it said.
The contract signalled that all foreign loans needed for the subway had been settled, it said.
So far, the city has borrowed a total of $540 million in loans from Germany, Japan, the U.S. and Britain to fund the subway.
